scope: Classical high-speed CAN passive linear trunk; cable-only illustrative propagation model

claims.claim: The CAN physical bus is shared multidrop and multimaster, not a master/slave topology
claims.locator: CAN two-wire bus multi-master, multi-drop topology

claims.claim: Typical high-speed CAN linear trunk places 120-ohm termination at the two physical endpoints
claims.locator: 120 Ω resistors at extreme bus ends

claims.claim: Special transceiver topologies may support more complex multi-stub arrangements than ordinary high-speed CAN
Four identical 120-ohm terminations in parallel create a 30-ohm DC load
A 40m main line with assumed 5ns/m one-way delay has cable-only 400ns round-trip
claims.notes: 5 ns/m is an explicitly illustrative assumption, not a protocol maximum.

claims.claim: End-to-end CAN physical viability depends on propagation budget, branch geometry and devices; common cable-length tables are not universal ISO maxima
